reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Spec cross-reference confirms that get_beacon_proposer_index (SG-005) should use proposer_lookahead[slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH] per EIP-7917. Code reading verified that all three gossip verification paths (data_column L688, blob L536, block L991) call get_beacon_proposer_indices which recomputes from active validators instead of reading proposer_lookahead. However, this is BY DESIGN for gossip validation. Gossip paths validate unverified messages before they are added to the canonical chain, using cheap_state_advance_to_obtain_committees which is specifically designed for this purpose. The recomputation pattern is defensive: gossip validation must not trust potentially stale cached proposer_lookahead values from parent states that may be on different forks or epochs. The spec requirement for proposer_lookahead applies to canonical state operations (block processing, validator duties), not adversarial gossip validation. All three paths explicitly cache the recomputed proposers after validation (beacon_proposer_cache.insert), showing this is intentional caching strategy. No evidence of state inconsistencies causing consensus splits - proposer_lookahead is updated during epoch processing (process_proposer_lookahead in single_pass.rs L469-503), and partial_state_advance correctly triggers epoch processing when crossing epoch boundaries (per_slot_processing.rs L42-48). The supposed attack scenario (divergence between proposer_lookahead and recomputed values) cannot occur because both use the same underlying state and validator set.
